Name: DE-CommentsReplies
Statement:
select  rpl.Oid as ReplyId,
        cmt.Oid as CommentsId,
        cmt.DocumentOid as DocumentId,
        cmt.DocumentTypeName as DocumentType,
        cre.Id as CreatedById,
        cre.Name as CreatedBy,
        cre.HasImage as CreatedByHasImage,
        rpl.Text,
        rpl.CreatedOnUtc,
        rpl.ModifiedOnUtc,
        rpl.ReactionsJson as Reactions,
        rpl.MentionsJson as Mentions
from    PostComment rpl
                join Post cmt on cmt.Oid = rpl.Post
                join UserLookup cre on cre.Id = rpl.CreatedBy
